info.description: `/v1/public` exposes public event and market data. `/v1/private` provides trading and account operations authenticated with a user token or API key.

post.description: Create an order for the authenticated account. Set `timestamp` to the current Unix time in milliseconds for every request. `expiration` is required for `GTD` and must use Unix milliseconds. For non-`MARKET` orders, `price` must be between 0 and 1, exclusive, and align with the market tick size.

409.description: Market is not tradable or the request was rejected by risk controls

post.description: Synchronously submit 1 to 50 orders and return the result for each item. Set each `timestamp` to the current Unix time in milliseconds. `expiration` accepts Unix seconds or milliseconds; the service converts seconds to milliseconds.

400.description: The list is empty, exceeds 50 items, or contains invalid order parameters

409.description: Market is not tradable or the request was rejected by risk controls

averagePrice.description: Average execution price of the position

currentValue.description: Position value at the current price

toWin.description: Maximum payout if the outcome resolves true

tradedValue.description: Position cost at the average execution price

avgCostPrice.description: Average cost after the trade. Empty when unavailable.

isImplied.description: Whether this is a combined or implied trade

error.description: Human-readable error message, usually containing a stable error identifier

midpoint.description: Midpoint of the best bid and best ask

interval.description: History window applied by the service

points.description: Market data for each outcome token

items.description: Markets on the current page. Uses the same field contract as `events.markets`.

volume.description: Sum of cumulative trading volume across all markets in the event

orderMinTickSize.description: Minimum tick size. Order prices must be an integer multiple of this value.

isCarousel.description: Whether this is a carousel tag

success.description: Whether the batch was submitted successfully
Whether the batch was submitted successfully

reasonCode.description: Rejection reason code. Usually `0` on success.

price.description: Order price. Optional for `MARKET`; otherwise must be between 0 and 1, exclusive, and align with the tick size.

size.description: Order quantity in whole shares as a positive integer

timeInForce.description: Time in force. `LIMIT` orders default to `GTC`; `MARKET` orders support only `IOC`.

timestamp.description: Request time in Unix milliseconds. Use the current time for every submission.

tokenId.description: Outcome token ID as a positive decimal integer
